_comment: The top-15 fault list, transcribed verbatim from Ductective-Plan-v3.md §3.
This is a COVERAGE REFERENCE, not a scenario set and not a smoke set.
Stage 5 does not author scenarios — Eval (5.5) owns the scenario set (E7.1) and
Knowledge (2.5) owns the retrieval smoke set (E2.2). An agent that writes its own
test cases and then grades itself against them has measured nothing. This file
exists only so those two sets can be checked for full coverage of the plan's list.
`refusal: true` marks a fault that must trigger a hard refusal under CLAUDE.md's
advise-only rule. The plan tags two of these explicitly as (advise-only); charge
verification is marked here because breaking into the sealed system is EPA 608
regulated work and falls under the refrigerant-handling category.

faults.name: refrigerant charge verification via PT chart + superheat/subcool
unit-specific error codes off the Trane/Carrier boards
